title.en: The era of peripheral wire bonding

subtitle.zh: 旧路线不是落后，而是曾经正好满足了产品的约束。
subtitle.en: The earlier route was not obsolete; it met the product constraints of its time.

body.zh: 边缘焊线（Wire Bond）芯片Wire Bond引线框架
body.en: Peripheral wire bonding (Wire Bond) Chip Wire Bond Lead frame

body.zh: 工艺成熟成本合适返修经验丰富
body.en: Mature process Appropriate cost Extensive rework experience

body.zh: 许多低速、I/O数有限的器件导线长度并没有成为首要矛盾。
body.en: For many low-speed devices with limited I/O counts, Wire length was not the primary limitation.

body.zh: 凸点与基板连接芯片凸点基板基板焊盘
body.en: Bumps connect to the substrate Chip Bumps Substrate Substrate pads

body.zh: 高密度连接把原本分散在芯片边缘的误差，集中到凸点阵列、基板布线和装配对准的共同窗口里。
body.en: High-density interconnection concentrates errors formerly distributed around the chip perimeter Into a shared window for the bump array, substrate routing and assembly alignment.

body.zh: 带来的工艺与验证链路
body.en: The resulting process and validation chain

body.zh: 后续验证热路径和板级可靠性
body.en: Subsequent validation Thermal paths and board-level reliability

body.zh: 不同的连接方式服务于不同的产品约束。
body.en: Different interconnection methods serve different product constraints.
